description: Apply current-year and brought-forward losses in statutory order (s.70 within a head, s.71 across heads with the Rs 2,00,000 house-property cap and no business loss against salary, then ss.71B/72/73/74 oldest first) and report each step with its section, income by head after set-off, what is carried forward with the last year it can be used (house property 8, business 8, speculative 4, capital 8 years), what expired, what s.80 forfeits on a late return, and Schedule CYLA/BFLA/CFL rows. `forComputeTax` goes into compute_tax or tax_summary field for field, with nothing added (do not also pass houses there).

broughtForward.description: Losses brought forward from earlier years: one entry per kind and origin year, from last year's Schedule CFL

amount.description: Unabsorbed amount at the start of this year, positive, in INR

originFy.description: FY the loss arose in, e.g. '2021-22' (the AY 2022-23 row of Schedule CFL)

business.description: Business or profession other than speculation (F&O included), net: profit or a NEGATIVE loss, in INR

capitalGains.description: Capital gains and losses of the year

longTermLoss.description: Long-term capital losses of the year, positive, in INR

ltcg112A.description: s.112A LTCG BEFORE the exemption, in INR

ltcgOther.description: s.112 LTCG (property, unlisted shares, other long-term assets), in INR

shortTermLoss.description: Short-term capital losses of the year, positive, in INR

stcgOther.description: STCG at slab rates (debt funds under s.50AA, unlisted shares, short-term property), in INR

filedByDueDate.description: The return for THIS year is filed by the s.139(1) due date. If not, s.80 stops this year's business, speculative and capital losses from being carried forward (house property survives, s.71B). list_tax_years `status` says whether the date has passed.

fy.description: Fiscal year, e.g. '2025-26' (AY 2026-27); '2026-27' is tax year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act 2025

houseProperty.description: Income from house property for all houses together, in INR: positive income or a NEGATIVE loss (compute_house_property totals.income)

housePropertyType.description: Which kind of house a house-property LOSS comes from; 'letOut' for a figure from compute_house_property (its caps are already applied)

otherSources.description: Income from other sources at normal rates, in INR

regime.description: Tax regime: no house-property loss crosses heads under the new regime (s.115BAC(2)); run once per regime to compare

salaryIncome.description: Gross salary before the standard deduction, in INR

speculative.description: Speculative business (intraday equity), net: profit or a NEGATIVE loss, in INR

name: compute_loss_setoff
title: Set off and carry forward losses
